_comment: Configuration for live monetization telemetry directly from Google AdMob and Google Play Console

adMob.note: Set your AdMob Publisher ID above. Authorize your service-account.json email in AdMob Settings -> Users & Permissions to enable direct network ad reports.

googlePlay.note: Paste your Cloud Storage URI from Play Console -> Download Reports -> Financial Reports. Grant your Service Account the Storage Object Viewer role in GCP IAM.
